Fig. S1 Data summary of the co-substrate ratio variation experiment under anaerobic (AN) and micro-aerobic (MA) conditions (a). Data summary of organic loading rate variation experiment under anaerobic (AN) and micro-aerobic (MA) conditions (b). Yellow-to-green heatmap indicates low-to-high values across the dataset.

Fig. S2 Effects of micro-aeration for 9.6 hrs with an intensity of 17 mL-O2/L·hr with an oxidation-reduction potential (ORP) of +25 mV above baseline ORP during system inhibition under an organic loading rate (OLR) of 5.0 g VS/L·d on alkalinity (a), total volatile fatty acids (VFAs) concentration (b), and specific biogas and methane yield (c).

Fig. S3 Non-metric multidimensional scaling (NMDS) plot with two dimensions using a Bray Curtis dissimilarity matrix of biomass samples (a). Bubble chart showing the alpha diversity indices: InvSimpson (1/D) on the y-axis and Shannon index (H’) on the x-axis, with bubble sizes representing the richness index (b). Relative abundance of key syntrophic acetate-oxidizing bacteria (SAOB) (c). Triangles indicate an organic loading rate (OLR) of 2.25 g VS/L·d, diamonds for an OLR of 4 g VS/L·d, and circles for micro-aerobic (MA) and an OLR of 6 g VS/L·d. MA: Micro-aeration; MD: mono-digestion; NR: Non-recirculation; OLR: Organic loading rate.
